anomaly.summary: 'Tie' is the most-tipped selection on 13 of 15 captured handball events, including every EHF Champions League fixture.
anomaly.why_it_matters: A draw is a low-probability outcome in handball. A consensus of 56-78% on 'Tie' across many independent matches is not credible tipster behaviour. Either OLBG's handball money line is a three-way market whose default/placeholder label is being surfaced as the top selection, or the tip aggregation for this sport is mis-mapped.
anomaly.action_taken: The OLBG tip distribution is NOT used as a probability anchor for handball. Every handball row is priced only where an official strength source exists; otherwise the line is left null and the row is flagged.
anomaly.corroboration: Session 53f44a7c independently recorded 'unusual handball tie selections' in its 2026-10-26 completion record, so this is reproducible across two separate captures on different days.

notes: Competitions observed: EHF Champions League (men), Swedish SHE (women), German Bundesliga. Several fixtures are 29 Oct and 'Tomorrow', i.e. midweek EHF Champions League round.
